title: Conformance Expectations Consent Server
publisher: HL7 International / Community Based Collaborative Care

contact.name: HL7 International / Community Based Collaborative Care

description: Conformance Expectations Requirements for Consent Server

statement.label: requirement-1157
statement.requirement: Consent Server systems SHALL be capable of processing resource instances containing data elements without generating an error or causing the application to fail.

statement.label: requirement-1159
statement.requirement: Consent Server systems SHALL interpret missing data elements within resource instances as data not being present in the sending system or not being shareable for privacy or other business reasons.

statement.label: requirement-1160
statement.requirement: Consent Server systems SHALL be able to process resource instances containing data elements that have extensions in place of a value where such extensions are declared as part of the profile.
